data.name: Joodatun
data.long_meaning: Joodatun is an Arabic name for girls which means 'a gift from Allah'. This beautiful name is derived from the Arabic word 'Jood' which means 'gift'. It signifies the belief that every child is a gift from Allah and is blessed with unique talents and abilities. The name also conveys the idea of being grateful for the blessings of parenthood and the gift of life.
data.spiritual_meaning: Joodatun is a name that reflects the spiritual belief in the gift of life and the blessings of Allah. It is a reminder of the divine origin of every human being and the importance of living a life that honors and cherishes this gift.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Joodatun has a Life Path Number of 11 which is considered a Master Number in numerology. It signifies spiritual growth, intuition, and the ability to manifest one's dreams and desires. It also represents the potential to be a leader and a healer.

in_arabic.name: جوداتون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جود و عطاء و سخاء

in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام کا مطلب ہے کرم، عطا، اور سخاء، جو کہ اسلامی تقویم میں اہم صفات ہیں، اور یہ نام ان صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک مسلمان کو حاصل کرنا چاہئے

in_hindi.name: जोदतुन
